caption:
🚂 Austria-Hungary's railways, built at their real dates — 1827 → today.

Look for the two stars: lines converge on Vienna in the west and on Budapest in the east 🗺️ After the 1867 Compromise, Hungary ran its own railway policy and built its network around its own capital. Most of these rails were laid by a single empire before 1918; today they belong to a dozen countries, the colours you see.

📊 Data: OpenHistoricalMap (opening and closure dates) + OpenStreetMap (gaps), ODbL. Coverage is uneven; about 3% of the km carry an estimated opening year. Borders of 1914: CShapes 2.0.
🌍 Land: Natural Earth
